alt: 學生帶著討好的笑容向社團教練深深鞠躬，雙手奉上整理好的鉛筆，希望獲得隊長職位。
scene_prompt: 搖尾乞憐 means a person humbly flatters someone to obtain a favor. In a modern school club, one student leans forward with an ingratiating smile, clasped hands and an exaggeratedly deferential bow while presenting a small gift of neatly arranged pencils to the club coach, clearly hoping to be selected team captain. The coach looks thoughtful rather than automatically approving, and another student waits quietly. Show excessive flattering behavior seeking a favor, not ordinary gratitude or kindness; no literal dog and no money. Natural anatomy, hands and bowing posture plausible, pencils and table physically grounded.
